package recording_test

import (
	bitwire "github.com/Bitspark/bitwire/wire/go"
	"context"
	handles "example.test/generated/api/go/handles-protocol"
	binding "example.test/generated/api/go/mixed-binding"
	client "example.test/generated/api/go/mixed-client"
	protocol "example.test/generated/api/go/mixed-protocol"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/duplex/go"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/live/go"
	"github.com/Bitspark/nightseam/runtime/go"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type mixedDestination struct {
	values chan protocol.Payload[string, handles.Box]
}

func (d mixedDestination) Changed(_ context.Context, value protocol.Payload[string, handles.Box]) error {
	d.values <- value
	return nil
}
func TestMixedTypeAndFamilyRecording(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	scope := localScope(t)
	owner := scope.Owner().Child()
	defer owner.Release()
	environment := runtime.AdapterContext{ValueEnvironment: live.ValueEnvironment(scope)}
	values := make(chan protocol.Payload[string, handles.Box], 4)
	makeTarget := func() (bitwire.Endpoint, error) {
		return client.ToWire(func(protocol.Server[string, handles.Box]) (protocol.Client[string, handles.Box], error) {
			return protocol.Client[string, handles.Box]{Events: mixedDestination{values}}, nil
		}, environment, runtime.JSONAdapter[string](), handles.AdapterBox())
	}
	target, err := makeTarget()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer target.Close(1000, "")
	store := duplex.NewMemoryWireLog()
	if _, err := binding.Record[string, handles.Box, handles.Tag](ctx, target, store, duplex.RecordOptions{}, environment, runtime.JSONAdapter[string](), runtime.ValueAdapter[handles.Box]{}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing family interpretation accepted")
	}
	if head, err := store.Head(ctx); err != nil || head != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("failed setup touched history: %d %v", head, err)
	}
	recorder, err := binding.Record(ctx, target, store, duplex.RecordOptions{}, environment, runtime.JSONAdapter[string](), handles.AdapterBox())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer recorder.Close(1000, "")
	payload := protocol.Payload[string, handles.Box]{Item: "native", Callback: handles.Box{Invoke: func(_ context.Context, n int64) (int64, error) { return n + 10, nil }}}
	if err := recorder.Append(live.WithOwner(ctx, owner), binding.RecordedChanged[string, handles.Box]{Data: payload}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	receive := func() {
		select {
		case value := <-values:
			if value.Item != "native" {
				t.Fatal(value.Item)
			}
			if got, err := value.Callback.Invoke(ctx, 2); err != nil || got != 12 {
				t.Fatalf("callback: %d %v", got, err)
			}
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatal(ctx.Err())
		}
	}
	receive()
	second, err := makeTarget()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer second.Close(1000, "")
	follower, err := recorder.Follow(ctx, 0, second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer follower.Close()
	receive()
	if owner.Counts().Exports != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("recording duplicated conversion: %+v", owner.Counts())
	}
}
